name: Pew Pew Dose 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Pew Pew Dose is a wild 3D arcade shooter where creativity meets chaos in a colorful post-apocalyptic world. Build your dream weapon from scratch; stack barrels, extend magazines, and fuse parts into over-the-top designs that blast waves of adorable yet deadly zombie rascals.
